info.title: SuSuMonitor Server Management API
info.description: Authoritative contract for secure server management. JSON property names use snake_case. Credential plaintext and ciphertext are request-only implementation concerns and are never returned by any response.

get.description: Available to any authenticated user. Returns non-deleted servers without credential plaintext or ciphertext.

post.description: Admin only. The primary credential matching ssh_auth_type is required. password and private_key are mutually exclusive, blank credentials are invalid, and responses never contain credential plaintext or ciphertext.

get.description: Available to any authenticated user. Returns a non-deleted server without credential plaintext or ciphertext.

put.description: Admin only. All basic fields are required. Omitting password and private_key retains the stored primary credential when ssh_auth_type is unchanged. Blank credentials and submitting both credential types are invalid. Changing ssh_auth_type requires the new matching primary credential. Responses never contain credential plaintext or ciphertext.

delete.description: Admin only. Soft-deletes the server; no credential plaintext or ciphertext is returned.

get.description: Available to any authenticated user. Returns the latest status snapshot stored in the database. It does not trigger and must not be interpreted as a real-time probe.

put.summary: Confirm or rotate SSH host key
put.description: Admin only. Performs target validation and an SSH handshake to compare the observed host key with expected_fingerprint, but never sends password, private key, passphrase, or any other login credential. A first confirmation stores the key, replace=true explicitly rotates a different stored key, and confirming the currently stored key is an idempotent review.

200.description: Host key confirmed, rotated, or reviewed without change

post.description: Admin only. Accepts no request body. Requires an already registered host key, validates the handshake against that exact key, and then tests the server's stored password or private_key credential. It never registers, replaces, or updates a host key and closes the connection without executing a command or creating a PTY.

200.description: SSH host key and stored credential verified

post.description: Admin only. Generates a one-time Agent Token. The database stores only its SHA-256 hash.
Admin only. Replaces the existing Agent Token and immediately invalidates the old token.

delete.description: Admin only. Revokes the current Agent Token and marks the Agent offline.

post.description: Issues a one-time ticket for /ws/monitor. The ticket expires exactly at expires_at, 30 seconds after issue. A long-lived JWT and Agent Token are never placed in the WebSocket URL.

get.description: Admin only. Returns the most recent SSH connection test records (success and failure) for a server, newest first.

post.description: Admin only. Connects to the target host and reads its actual host public key without registering or sending credentials. Returns the observed algorithm and fingerprint for the administrator to confirm before trusting.

bearerAuth.description: JWT supplied only through the Authorization: Bearer <token> request header.

Keyword.name: keyword
Keyword.description: Optional keyword matched against server name, host or description.

XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
XCorrelationId.description: Optional client correlation ID. Invalid values are ignored and never logged.

XRequestId.description: UUID request ID generated by the server. Client-provided X-Request-ID values are ignored.

XCorrelationId.description: Optional validated client correlation ID, returned only when a valid request header was provided.

ApiResponse.description: Unified API response envelope. Concrete responses specialize data with allOf.

PageResult.description: Unified pagination result. Concrete page responses specialize items with allOf.

ssh_password.description: Non-blank password credential. Never returned or logged.

ssh_private_key.description: Non-blank private key credential. Never returned or logged.

ssh_private_key_passphrase.description: Optional non-blank private key passphrase. Never returned or logged.

CreateServerRequest.description: Create request. Exactly one matching primary credential is required; submitting both types is invalid.

UpdateServerRequest.description: All basic fields are required. Credentials may be omitted only to retain the existing credential when ssh_auth_type is unchanged. If ssh_auth_type changes, the service must require the matching new primary credential. Submitting both credential types or an empty credential is invalid.

agent_token.description: Returned only once during register or rotate; never returned by server query endpoints.

ticket.description: One-time ticket returned by this endpoint and consumed during /ws/monitor handshake.

Server.description: Safe server representation. Credential plaintext and ciphertext fields are deliberately absent.

status.description: Latest status value stored in the database; not a real-time probe.

ServerStatus.description: Database status snapshot. Reading it does not perform a real-time probe.

expected_fingerprint.description: Expected OpenSSH SHA-256 host key fingerprint verified by the administrator through a trusted out-of-band channel.

replace.description: Must be true to replace a different registered fingerprint after an administrator verifies a legitimate host key rotation.

error_code.description: 失败时的业务错误码(50002/50003/50400 等)，成功为 NULL

host_key_algorithm.description: 成功时的远端主机公钥算法

host_key_fingerprint.description: 成功时的远端主机公钥指纹

host_key_algorithm.description: 观察到的远端主机公钥算法

host_key_fingerprint.description: 观察到的远端主机公钥 SHA-256 指纹

registered_fingerprint.description: 当前已登记的主机公钥指纹，未确认过为 null；与观察指纹不同表示密钥已变更

InvalidRequestParameter.description: Invalid request parameter or credential combination

Unauthorized.description: Bearer JWT is missing, invalid, expired, or no longer authorized

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

SshForbidden.description: The caller is not an admin or the SSH target violates the outbound access policy

NotFound.description: Server does not exist or has been deleted

Conflict.description: Server name, host, concurrent state, or delete constraint conflicts with the request

SshHostKeyConflict.description: The host key is not registered, does not match, or changed concurrently

SshConnectionLimitExceeded.description: SSH connection test concurrency limit reached

SshConnectionFailed.description: The SSH handshake or stored credential authentication could not be completed

SshTimeout.description: SSH DNS resolution, TCP connection, handshake, authentication, or total operation timed out
